scope: Mobile-first correction of motion and image interaction
changes: Removed pointer-driven artwork tilt and decorative tap bounce
Removed Motion whileHover from shared action buttons
Press feedback cancels when a pointer moves more than 10 CSS pixels or the container scrolls
Added two-pointer pinch, bounded pan, and double-tap zoom to image viewer with visible button alternatives
Expanded key touch controls to 48 CSS pixels; quantity controls to 44 CSS pixels
Retained action-driven cart feedback, counters and selected navigation states

browserChecks: Artwork transform unchanged on pointer movement
Zoom-in and reset controls update image state
Viewer controls measured at 48 CSS pixels high

limitations: This is a React web application. Physical-device gesture behavior still needs verification.
